arguments: {"test_id": "T1", "per_hypothesis": [{"id": "H1", "verdict": "supported", "why": "Residue 28 lies within 4.5 \u00c5 of an organic ligand in 32 of the 39 ligand-bound structures that observe it. The inositol-phosphate ligand 4IP contacts it in PDB 1BWN (chain B) at 2.75 \u00c5, with 4 of 6 4IP instances in contact. Negative-control ligands (3IS, 72V, A1JS1, IS7, MG, NYQ, Q1B, ZN) never contact residue 28. The refutation criterion (no contact with the inositol phosphate in 1B55 or related structures) was not met. Sources: E10, E18, T1."}, {"id": "H2", "verdict": "unchanged", "why": "T1 measures ligand proximity in crystal structures, not folding stability, so it does not bear on the ddG or local-fold criterion in H2's would_refute. The stability test T2 has not been run."}, {"id": "H3", "verdict": "unchanged", "why": "T1 has no information on oligomer or dimer interfaces. The structural-context test T3, which would test the interface, has not been run."}], "uncertainty": "All results are computational predictions and are not validated experimentally. The contacts come from deposited crystal structures, but the effect of R28H is inferred, not measured. A crystal contact with a soluble ligand is not a measurement of binding by the variant protein, and absence of a ligand structure is not evidence of absence of binding. The 2.58 \u00c5 closest contact is to 4PT (2Z0P) and the 4IP contact is 2.75 \u00c5 (1BWN), so the contact is supported by two different ligand sets. Most of the 39 structures carry synthetic tetrahydrobenzofuran ligands, not inositol phosphate, so the 32/39 count is not specific to the IP4 pocket. The site-state control is weak: the four R28C structures (6TT2, 6TSE, 1BTK, 6YYF) show zero contacts, but their ligands were ions or non-contacting ligands, so this does not show that losing Arg28 abolishes ligand contact. The test cannot separate a direct phosphate contact from a neighbouring-pocket effect. Still needed: an R28H structure or model with the IP4 pose, a binding assay for R28H, and the stability (T2) and interface (T3) tests. The pathogenicity scores (AlphaMissense 0.998, popEVE -5.63, ScoreCons 0.962) and the ClinVar Pathogenic classification are also computational or clinical records and are not experimental validation of the mechanism.\"}]"}
